meta.name: ambientui Design System
meta.description: Serialized master of the ambientui token system. THE SCALES OF RECORD ARE TAILWIND'S — the full color palette, the spacing scale, and the type scale ship with Tailwind v4 (emitted as CSS variables via theme(static)). This file records how the Foundation SELECTS from them; foundation-context.tsx implements the mapping. When they diverge, this file wins and the code is corrected.

palette.$comment: Tailwind's color palette, verbatim — every family × steps 50-950 as --color-{family}-{step}. Documented live at /ds → Colors. Components never touch steps directly; they consume the semantic roles below.

roles.$comment: THE ROLE MAP — the entire color contract. Each role is one visual job; its light/dark step is a DEFAULT the saved config (foundation.roles) can override, edited live on the Foundation page (/ds → Foundation → Semantic mapping). Labels and descriptions are carried in code by ROLE_DEFS (foundation-context.tsx) and documented in DESIGN.md §9's role glossary; the three lists must not diverge. Aliases mirror the role's value under shadcn's other names — never set independently. --primary-foreground stays paired automatically (white, or neutral-950 on light hues amber/yellow/lime). LIGHT IS THE DESIGN DECISION: picking a light step derives the dark one (deriveDark - gray roles mirror the scale, accent roles keep their default offset); explicit dark picks override until the next light pick.

--primary.label: Action color
--primary.paints: Filled buttons, switches and checks when on, the active nav accent

--ring.label: Focus ring
--ring.paints: The outline around whichever control has keyboard focus

--app-blue.label: Ambient accent
--app-blue.paints: The assistant layer's chips, links, and highlights

--background.label: Page background
--background.paints: The ground every screen sits on

--muted.label: Quiet fill
--muted.paints: Hover and selected states, subtle chips, secondary surfaces

--accent-foreground.label: Text on quiet fill
--accent-foreground.paints: Text sitting on the quiet fill

--sidebar.label: Sidebar ground
--sidebar.paints: The navigation rail's tint and the shell behind the inset content card

radius.$comment: Tailwind's radius scale, verbatim — the scale of record. The saved config picks ONE step; that step becomes --radius (and rounded-lg), and the named steps slide with it as a window on this same ramp, so every emitted value is a Tailwind radius. Emitted in rem over the scaling base.

retired.note: 20px was on the invented ramp and exists on no Tailwind scale; saved configs migrate to the nearest step.

spacingUnits.$comment: Spacing is Tailwind's scale; the Foundation sets its UNIT — the --spacing variable every utility (p-4, gap-2, h-9) derives from. Nominal px at the 100% base, emitted in rem.

scaling.$comment: The base layer. Presets map to a concrete root font-size; every rem-based dimension (type, spacing, radius) rides it. 100% = 16px.

shadows.$comment: Tailwind's shadow scale is the elevation scale of record, used as-is (no Foundation config — elevation is chosen per surface by meaning). Documented at /ds → Shadows.

icons.$comment: The icon library is a Foundation choice; components — including the packages/ui primitives, via IconLibraryProvider — use semantic names through <Icon> (packages/ui/src/components/icon.tsx). New names must be mapped in every library.

fonts.$comment: --font-sans is a Foundation choice. Geist ships locally; Google families load on demand via one managed <link>.

type.$comment: Tailwind's type scale (text-xs … text-9xl), rem-based. px shown at the 16px base.

ambient.$comment: Assistant-layer tokens. --app-blue is the accent bridge (see foundation.accent.mapping). viz roles are status colors used by processing states.

blur.$comment: --ambient-blur: the one glass blur radius. Every AI surface (bar, panel, dock, spotlight, orb shell) wears the .ambient-glass recipe in packages/ambient/src/ambient.css - the --glass-fill tint over blur(var(--ambient-blur)) saturate(1.5). Never a one-off blur on an ambient surface.

orb.$comment: OrbCharacter config lives in the saved Foundation config (orb.useAccent / orb.colors cold→hot heat ramp / orb.speeds per state), configured on /ds → OrbCharacter.

figma.$comment: Connection is set on the Foundation page (/ds → Foundation) and stored in the saved config as figmaFileUrl. Mapping: figma/tokens-figma-map.json. Procedure: figma/figma-sync.md.

lastSync.note: Primitives are NOMINAL Tailwind values; the 95% scaling is recorded as Scale/Factor 0.875 rather than baked into every number, so Figma shows the design values and the runtime multiplier is legible.

model.$comment: Two primitive collections and one semantic one. Primitives hold scales VERBATIM and never bend to the config; the Foundation holds no numbers at all — every token is an alias at the primitive the saved config selected. Re-pointing one alias re-themes the file exactly as changing the config re-themes the app.
model.Palette: Tailwind's colour ramps, 22 families × 11 steps + base white/black (244)
model.Tailwind Primitives: border radius, gap, padding, opacity, max-w, font size — Tailwind's nominal values (120)
model.Foundation: semantic roles, Light/Dark: Color/* → Palette, Radius/* + Spacing/Unit + Type/* → Tailwind Primitives, plus Scale/Root font size and Scale/Factor (33)

motion.$comment: THE MOTION SYSTEM - motion is a Foundation dimension. Components consume roles, never literal timings; character + pace (foundation config `motion`) decide every role's feel. Tailwind's default transition duration/easing map onto micro/ease. Implemented in foundation-context.tsx (MOTION_CHARACTERS/MOTION_ROLES, useMotionTransition/useMotionSpring); documented at /ds -> Motion.

roles.--motion-micro: hover/press/focus feedback; the default for every transition-* utility
roles.--motion-control: control state changes - checks, switches, selection

motion.exception: The orb's identity springs (its cadence is its own Foundation config)

translucency.$comment: THE TRANSLUCENCY TOKENS (packages/ambient/src/ambient.css) - every alpha in the system is one of these; no raw /NN opacity modifiers or ad-hoc color-mix in component code. All derive from semantic roles, so the role map retints them.

tokens.--glass-fill: popover 55% - the ambient glass body (.ambient-glass, blur 48 + saturate 1.5)
tokens.--wash: accent 40% - quiet fills at rest (chips, selected cards)
tokens.--glass-wash: foreground 9% - neutral fills ON glass: palette selection/hover, keycap chips
tokens.--glass-veil: popover 62% - the frost between a heat field (OrbField) and surface content (.ambient-field-frost)
tokens.--glass-veil-stage: popover 48% - the veil over a STAGE field: canvas grounds, projector surfaces (.ambient-stage-frost)
tokens.--glass-scrim: popover 82% - a full-screen ambient surface (History) covering the product (.ambient-scrim)
tokens.--glass-veil-screen: popover 92% - the veil over a full-presence field across a whole window (.ambient-screen-frost)
